transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

I've been having a really hard time focusing and paying attention to details, which has been causing me to make a lot of careless mistakes. I also just feel quite restless and have a hard time sitting still.
Do you also often interrupt others, blurt out answers, or act without thinking, or is it mostly trouble focusing and feeling restless?

No, I don't really struggle with interrupting others or blurting things out. It is definitely more about my trouble focusing—like making careless mistakes and failing to finish tasks or chores—and feeling so restless that I often get up from my seat when I'm expected to stay seated.
Have you had enough symptoms of hyperactivity or impulsivity, like fidgeting, leaving your seat, or feeling driven to move, to cause problems in more than one setting such as work, school, or home?

Yes, I definitely struggle with leaving my seat when I'm expected to stay seated, and it happens both during meetings at work and when I'm at home. I'm not really sure about other symptoms like constant fidgeting, but the urge to get up is definitely a problem in those different places.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Combined Presentation), Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Inattentive Presentation)], but the interview now shows clinically significant hyperactive symptoms as well as inattentive symptoms. The patient reports leaving their seat when expected to stay seated in more than one setting, which supports combined presentation rather than predominantly inattentive presentation.
